title: Partnerships / Marketplace — Daily scratchpad
todos: Confirm next-step owner for ModelMart sandbox (Ava)
Finalize API key rotation approach + docs (Samir)
Ask infra for temporary quota bump for integration testing (eng-infra request)
Schedule follow-up with ModelMart legal about data handling (Mateo)
Add telemetry events to list that product needs to surface (track:enable)
Prepare demo script showing fallback to smaller model for latency-sensitive calls
content:
Quick notes from today (scratchpad) — chaotic but capturing everything I don't want to forget.

Summary / context:
- Working through first partner onboarding for new marketplace flow. ModelMart is the pilot partner; they want a hosted integration + optional private deployment later.
- Main goals today: lock sandbox access, validate API contract (auth + rate limits), confirm billing split / revenue share model broadly, and identify infra blockers for perf tests.

Meeting notes (02/27 sync):
- ModelMart asked for sample throughput: 50 qps sustained, spike to 200 qps for 10m. Need to confirm if Dedicated burst handles this or prefer routing across regions.
- They use OAuth2 client credentials for auth; prefer token rotation every 30 days. They asked whether Redwood supports automatic rotation - currently manual. Action: Samir to propose rotation workflow.
- Data retention: they want logs for 90 days for debugging, but enterprise policy requires 30 days by default. Legal to weigh in.

Integration checklist (high-level, in-progress):
- [x] NDA signed (internal copy on Confluence)
- [ ] Sandbox instances provisioned (blocked: infra quota)
- [x] Initial API spec (openapi draft) shared with partner 
- [ ] API key / OAuth test flow validated end-to-end
- [ ] Telemetry + events instrumented for product (list + owners)
- [ ] Marketplace listing draft + assets
- [ ] Billing / revenue share draft + legal review
- [ ] Security review (SRE + secops) scheduled
- [ ] SLA / latency targets documented and agreed

Notes / questions (rough):
- Quota bump request: who is the right infra contact? Put in SRE queue but mark as high priority. If no bump, we can run perf tests at lower qps but may miss ModelMart's acceptance criteria.
- Thoughts on auth: could offer two modes — OAuth (preferred) and token-based for quick start. Need to clearly document token rotation expectations.
- Telemetry: product wants per-route tokenized cost breakdown; marketplace needs aggregated usage per partner for billing. Consider a partner_id header on requests so billing can map.

Follow-ups and owners (quick):
- Ava: confirm sandbox provisioning timeline with infra (due 2026-03-04)
- Samir: draft token rotation proposal + sample scripts (due 2026-03-05)
- Mateo: coordinate legal review re: retention and revenue share (due 2026-03-06)
- Jordan: draft marketplace listing + pick 2 demo screenshots, rehearse demo (due 2026-03-04)

Demo script notes (to refine):
- Start w/ latency-sensitive flow -> show fallback to smaller model and consistent output quality checks.
- Show telemetry dashboard: per-request tokens, latency, cost estimate. Highlight that partner gets aggregated monthly invoice.
- Walkthrough of onboarding: sandbox auth -> test keys -> move to production (contract + billing)

Random scratch / ideas:
- Could offer a "marketplace quickstart" template repo that automatically creates sandbox creds + sample calls to reduce onboarding time. Ask devexp if they want to own.
- Consider an opt-in for partners to let Redwood surface anonymized usage examples in marketing. Legal will need to approve.

Short-term risks:
- Infra quota is the single biggest blocker for timeline; escalate if no response by EOD tomorrow.
- Legal retention mismatch might delay go-live if they insist on 90d logs. Need a compromise (longer retention only for debugging exports).

Useful links / refs:
- Confluence onboarding page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/marketplace-onboarding
- Initial API spec: (shared in Google Drive link — attach later)
- Jira epics: JIRA-7892 (ModelMart onboarding), JIRA-8010 (Marketplace billing plumbing)

End-of-day quick reflection:
- Prioritize infra ask and Samir's rotation doc tomorrow. Keep legal looped but don't wait on them for sandbox provisioning. If we can get sandbox up + basic auth working we can do a live demo that wins momentum.

-- j
